issues.claim: Отложенное выполнение и ленивые вычисления в LINQ / Deferred execution and lazy evaluation in LINQ
issues.problem: The fetched page is titled 'Deferred execution and lazy evaluation - LINQ to XML'. It supports the general idea of lazy, element-by-element iterators, but the link title drops the 'LINQ to XML' qualifier while the question is about LINQ to Objects.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the link titles match the page ('... (LINQ to XML)'). Optionally cite the Enumerable.Take Remarks text 'Take enumerates source and yields elements until count elements have been yielded' as the main support for early termination.

issues.claim: The `ILookup` indexer returns an empty sequence for a missing key instead of throwing.
issues.problem: This is true of ILookup<TKey,TElement>.Item[], but the cited ToLookup page excerpt does not show it. The generator notes say so too. Other ToLookup facts (immediate execution, and GroupBy being deferred) are also not visible in the truncated excerpt.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a link to https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.linq.ilookup-2.item (with ru and en linkTitles), or remove the empty-sequence sentence from both locales. Apply the same change to locales.ru.explanation.
